rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a neighborhood or local area, rather than the more slangy English feel of “hood.”

example.english: Our hood recently got a new cha chaan teng.
example.traditional: 我哋社區最近開咗間新茶記。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 se5 keoi1 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 san1 caa4 gei3

rows.note: Use this for the hinged cover over a car’s engine.

example.english: Did you close the hood properly?
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 gwaan1 sat6 ce1 tau4 goi3 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a cover or enclosure whose purpose is to protect something, especially from above.

example.english: Remember to put the hood back on the camera, or it will get scratched easily.
example.traditional: 記得幫個鏡頭裝返保護罩，唔係好易整花。
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 bong1 go3 geng3 tau4 zong1 faan2 bou2 wu6 zaau3 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 zing2 faa1
